justification: Sub-regions mapped to WB regions: Central -> Kalangala/Kampala group; Mid-Northern -> Northern group (Gulu, Lira, Arua); Mid-Western and South-Western -> Western group (Hoima, Mbarara, Kabale). Eastern not sampled.
